source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
As the [first battle round](vsdata:core-rule/start-of-battle-round) begins, pick 1 Hyper-adaptation; it is active for your **TYRANIDS** units until the battle ends. Attacks by **TYRANIDS** models with it gain:

- **Swarming Instincts**: **[[SUSTAINED HITS 1]](vsdata:weapon-ability/sustained-hits)** against **INFANTRY** or **SWARM** units.
- **Hyper-aggression**: **[[LETHAL HITS]](vsdata:weapon-ability/lethal-hits)** against **MONSTER** or **VEHICLE** units.
- **Hive Predators**: **[[PRECISION]](vsdata:weapon-ability/precision)** on a **[Critical Hit](vsdata:core-rule/hit-rolls)** against **CHARACTER** units.
